title: deps: Instantiate single uucode module and pass to vaxis; zig 0.16 fixes
body:
This PR switches uucode to a single module cached in the `SharedDeps` struct and passed to `libvaxis` with the `external_uucode` option in this PR: https://github.com/rockorager/libvaxis/pull/324

See the giant comment above `uucode_mod` for more info, including how this unfortunate state came to be from a Zig bug (that I'll be working to PR soon).

I used AI back and forth in a couple threads:

* https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019dca3f-5eb7-757a-9b2c-bc7eac1a6f2b - the first thread, getting passed the `uucode/uucode0` modules error
* https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019dca9d-c040-757b-bc78-e35e8c6f77f4 - trying to resolve more issues with Zig 0.16

This isn't building still on my mac (`zig build` using `zig` from `nix`) but it at least got to the `translate-c` and `@cImport` errors:
